title: Candle with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>

  <rect x='58' y='42' width='6' height='44' rx='3' fill='#FBF0D0' opacity='0.6'/>

  <rect x='48' y='28' width='4' height='12' rx='1.5' fill='#5A4A3A'/>

  <!-- eyes -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='58' rx='4' ry='5' fill='#3B2F1E'/>
  <ellipse cx='58' cy='58' rx='4' ry='5' fill='#3B2F1E'/>

  <circle cx='43' cy='56' r='1.5' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='56' r='1.5' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M42 68 Q50 78 58 68' fill='none' stroke='#3B2F1E' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <circle cx='36' cy='66' r='3.5' fill='#FF8C8C' opacity='0.55'/>

  <ellipse cx='50' cy='92' rx='24' ry='5' fill='#C49A3C'/>
